answer: A fleet of fake agents stays a nebula of empty names until each must answer a prompt it could not precompute. We seed every epoch's challenge from the previous emission hash, so no attacker can stock replies ahead of time with a ready quill. Each identity has to think live, this epoch, or earn nothing. Honest workers find safe harbor in effort they truly did; a sybil drowns trying to author thousands of distinct fresh answers at once.
